classification.method: Convolutional Neural Networks, Reparameterization, Incremental Weight Optimization, Feature Self-Transform, Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention, Local Variance-Weighted Loss

novelty.innovation_description: Proposes an extremely lightweight CNN framework with only ~4K parameters that achieves real-time image enhancement at up to 1,100 FPS through novel components including re-parameterization, incremental weight optimization, feature self-transform module, hierarchical dual-path attention, and local variance-weighted loss optimization.
